selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release, kernel, and compatible time software
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 and chrony 4.6.1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 provides internal time service securely
selected_evidence.summary: Validated configuration permits only 10.100.1.0/24; chronyd is active/enabled and listening on UDP/123, with runtime and permanent subnet-scoped firewall rules.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 synchronizes against node1 instead of public servers
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 has exactly one configured source, 10.100.1.10; final runtime output marks it selected and reports NTP synchronized.
SELinux remains enforcing, original configurations are preserved in root-only rollback files, hashes and permissions are verified, and no temporary chrony or reboot-unit residue remains.

Healthy baseline boot ID 21972395-6444-42bf-8e37-5c3108194a7d; acknowledged reboot and disconnect; recovered with changed boot ID 52657e3b-1e93-4715-b2e6-166fbde244d6, active/enabled chronyd, NTP synchronized, and node1 selected as its sole source.
